reviews.title: Great Headphones and super cute!
reviews.comment: No problems with this whatsoever! A bit of a weird thing, though it may be just my computer... if I connect the headphones into the headphone jack, it wont detect the mic at all. Thankfully an adapter is included and both the mic & headphones work just fine! It's comfy and doesn't hurt my head if I wear it for a long time. Mic sounds good, gotten compliments from my friends :)). I'd say it's worth it for the money!
reviews.author: Tash
